skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of information technology, computer systems, information systems, computer networks, and information security.
Understand the function of operating systems and basic usage of Windows 10.
Understand basic concepts of databases and database management systems.
Understand basic concepts of computer networks and internet services.
Understand basic concepts of information security and computer maintenance.
Master basic usage of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Develop independent learning skills and responsibility for self-study.
Demonstrate teamwork and responsibility in group activities.
Apply critical thinking to solve problems related to information technology.
